scope: Second Section 7 batch: David Hernandez, Friedrich Knop and Thomas Lam.

source_checks.limit: Structural checks validate recorded dependencies, source syntax and consistency; they do not establish semantic completeness or prove cited research results.

mathematical_review.independent_review: A separate read-only reviewer checked the three branches against the cited sources. The parent separately checked low-rank computations, hypotheses and source conventions.
corrections: The rank-one Drinfeld-to-Chevalley bridge includes q^-3 and q^3 rescalings, matching the local evaluation parameter and q-character. This repairs a mixed convention in new notes, not an alleged SIAM error.
Formal auxiliary traces use v_i=u^(alpha_i)=product_j u_j^(C_ji), with v-adic completion rather than unrestricted numerical convergence.
Coordinate-ring multiplication differences in the Knop outline are restricted to quasiaffine X.
The logarithmic semi-invariant derivative identity is restricted to Lie(B), or Lie(P) under the corresponding semi-invariance assumption.
additional_checks: Rank-one group-scheme norm, group law, inverse and disconnected smooth zero fibre.
Ordered quantum-loop tensor-product resonance and extension direction.
Gr(2,4) Pluecker signs, right-side residues, d! Euclidean polar-volume normalization and the one-dimensional Hessian sign.
Real nonnegative positroid cell closures are distinguished from complex positroid varieties; the general amplituhedron positive-geometry assertion remains a conjecture.
The general flag-residue theorem is cited; its local splitting proof is restricted to the stated no-complementary-face case.
mathematical_review.proof_boundary: Elementary constructions, calculations and deductions are written locally. Each packet distinguishes cited deep theorems and conjectures, records exact reading ranges, and lists unexpanded research proofs. No complete reconstruction of all proofs in the three reports is claimed.
mathematical_review.terminology: Existing Chinese terminology reused. Unavailable BananaSpace retrieval is recorded; no complete terminology alignment is asserted.

additional_checks: Public domain, canonical paths and search index.

browser.visual_result: Existing typography and reading layout preserved; headings and metadata wrap, navigation remains usable, formulas stay legible.

preservation.earlier_bourbaki_snapshot: Only the reviewed 006D landing-page hash refreshed after adding the shared Lam topic; no Bourbaki knowledge content changed.
